description: This file defines various classes and objects related to data partitioning strategies in Apache Spark, including abstract and concrete partitioner implementations such as HashPartitioner, RangePartitioner, and others. It manages how data is distributed across partitions for parallel processing.

classes.name: Partitioner
classes.description: Abstract class defining how key-value pairs are partitioned in RDDs, mapping keys to partition IDs.

classes.name: HashPartitioner
classes.description: Implements hash-based partitioning using Java's hashCode, distributing keys across partitions.

classes.name: PartitionIdPassthrough
classes.description: Partitioner that uses pre-computed partition IDs, suitable for (Int, Row) pairs.

classes.name: KeyGroupedPartitioner
classes.description: Partitions records based on a value map, ensuring records with the same key are in the same partition.

classes.name: ConstantPartitioner
classes.description: Partitions all records into a single partition.

classes.name: RangePartitioner
classes.description: Partitions sortable records into ranges based on sampled data, supporting range-based partitioning.

methods.name: defaultPartitioner
methods.description: Selects an appropriate partitioner for RDDs based on existing partitioners, default parallelism, and other criteria.

methods.name: isEligiblePartitioner
methods.description: Checks if a partitioner is within an order of magnitude of the maximum number of upstream partitions.

methods.name: sketch
methods.description: Samples the RDD to determine range bounds for range partitioning.

methods.name: determineBounds
methods.description: Calculates range bounds for partitioning based on sampled candidate keys and weights.
